dialogues.speaker: Hanachirusato
dialogues.text: That was well done — whether it was dealing with Ioroi's illusory tricks, or the way you defeated those demons.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Or so Paimon might have said, but this trick of yours is getting real old, Miss Masked Maiden.

dialogues.speaker: Hanachirusato
dialogues.text: Ah, so I disappointed you, then? I apologize. I'll do better next time.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: There's no need to "do better" at trivial things like this...

dialogues.speaker: Hanachirusato
dialogues.text: That is true. So, as for Ioroi... Is he doing well?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Even though he's been turned into stone.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: I see...

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Usually, when bake-danuki make a mess, we won't send anyone to deal with them as long as they don't cross the line. After all, although they are mischievous, they're kind-hearted and simple, just like children.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: But when Ioroi dared to steal the ward for the Cleansing Ritual, well, that was enough to get him punished. Since the "Yougou Three" were mentioned in your story, then it was probably Kamuna... an onmyouji from a past age, who did the deed.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Miss Masked Maiden, are you Ioroi's kitsune friend?

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: ...That's quite the compliment. He was actually talking about the daughter of the Hakushin bloodline, also known as the "Kitsune Saiguu." She was worshiped as the kitsune goddess in many places long ago.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: The Sky Kitsune and Earth Kitsune were once her emissaries. After she left, they all turned into stone statues to preserve their power and await her return — and when she does, they will all walk the Byakko Plain together once more.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Following her departure, the bloodline and mystical might of the kitsune on Narukami Island today have dwindled to less than one tenth of what they used to be...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Ioroi said "Our contest isn't over yet!"

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Oh, that. This is what happened. Did you know that Ioroi's full name is "Ioroi, the Hidden Protector of the Grove"?

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Ioroi may be dull and impish, but he is also kind and loyal. That's why the Kitsune Saiguu aimed to guide him to the right path a long time ago.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: In order to make sure that he would comply with the Electro Archon's rule, the Kitsune Saiguu set the two of them up and got Ioroi appointed as the Protector of the Grove. This made him responsible for the safety of the Chinju Forest.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: That's why, when the world became pitch black, the Kitsune Saiguu was worried that Ioroi might die while fighting against this inexorable evil in his capacity as protector of the forest.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: So she used a game of Hide-and-Seek, something the bake-danuki are good at, as a way to challenge him...

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: "Ioroi, whatever happens... they're all my magical tricks. Don't fall for them and don't show up," she said.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: "Of course, you sneaky kitsune. I will definitely defeat you this time," said Ioroi. And that's how their endless contest began.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...So Ioroi is still waiting for her to come back and find him?

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Based on what you said about Ioroi, that appears to be the case...

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: But after a while, Ioroi sensed that something was wrong and started wreaking havoc. He even stole the ward in an attempt to lure the Kitsune Saiguu out.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: He didn't realize that it was something required for the Sacred Sakura Cleansing Ritual. He just thought that it was a comb of some importance to the Kitsune Saiguu. Later on, Kamuna sealed him into stone due to that misstep.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: What about the Kitsune Saiguu, then?

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: ...She was swallowed up by the darkness. In the end, after that darkness was defeated, she returned to the great land of Narukami along with the soil.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: And who are you then?

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Me? As you can see, I am just "Hanachirusato." A shrine maiden who wants to borrow your strength to destroy these evils.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: That wasn't my question...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Miss Masked... Hanachirusato, it's really strange that you know so many things about the past that most people don't.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You even know how to use bake-danuki magic and cook tanuki dishes.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: But you don't know much about the present.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's almost like you're someone from a few centuries ago...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We also saw someone who looked like you in some memories. She even had the same name as you...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You must be just like Ioroi, a bake-danuki who was sealed several centuries ago!

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: N—No, that's not who I...

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: I inherited her memories. As for other things, please forgive me. I cannot speak of them yet.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: I made you a promise, back there in the cave. So when the time comes, I will reveal everything.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #What do we do, {NICKNAME}?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Okay, if you say so, Paimon will have some faith in Miss Masked Maiden too!

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Thank you for your understanding.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: Now, we must part here for the time being.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Goodbye.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: "We part in body alone, for our hearts drift with the clouds."

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: I will pray for your success beneath the well in Konda Village. I shall be next to the Thunder Sakura root that you cleansed successfully.

response.speaker: Hanachirusato
response.text: When the tree roots at all five places have been cleansed, please look for me there.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But he's very well!
